purpose: Teach: 迷宮/生業/生身/ディテール/恐怖症/遺書/言い渡し/私事

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、未解決事件の迷宮入りの社会的影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you wrote your paper on the social impact of unsolved crimes falling into the labyrinth, didn't you.
lines.style: Steady, observant. Warm but professional. The opening is genuine curiosity framed as acknowledgment. Clear diction, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統工芸を生業とする職人の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on the lives and craft of traditional artisans.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. A slight pause before the answer, gathering her thoughts. Quiet pride in the work, not performative. Even pacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 生身の人間を被写体とする報道倫理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored the ethics of portraying real people in documentary journalism, if I remember.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. The teacher is checking in, not correcting. Soft open on the statement. Patient rhythm that makes space for Sakura.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、歴史画のディテール描写の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the fine detail work and symbolism in historical painting.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. A slight deepening of tone on the main subject. She's grounding herself in the actual work she did. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会不安と恐怖症の関係性の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Social anxiety and phobia — you examined that relationship in your research, didn't you.
lines.style: Calm, observational. A gentle downward inflection that isn't a question but an invitation. The teacher is drawing her out. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の遺書の文学的研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the literary significance of wartime letters and final words.
lines.style: Quiet but steady. A weight to the words that respects the subject matter. Delivered without drama, but the gravity is there. Even breath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 判決の言い渡しの法社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The sociology of judgment — how verdicts are pronounced and received — that was your paper's focus.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. The teacher is connecting threads. Slow, deliberate pacing. A moment of recognition in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、研究者の私事と公務の境界を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the boundary between a researcher's private life and their public responsibility.
lines.style: Final answer, more assured. She's found her ground. Slight lift at the end on the key phrase. Grounded but open. Closing breath.
